description: Case-insensitive profile lookup: usernames are unique only case-sensitively, so iexact plus .first() picks one of several matching accounts, and follow/unfollow act on the wrong user.
notes: FM-11 (data semantics). User.username is unique only case-sensitively and registration doesn't normalize case, so `Jake` and `jake` can both exist. get_profile_or_404 filters `username__iexact` and takes `.first()`, which under the model's `-created_at` ordering silently picks the newest matching account. GET /profiles/Jake can return jake's profile, and POST or DELETE follow then act on the wrong user, a persisted wrong follow. Severity important: FM-11 is important when wrong data persists or is acted on. Fix: prefer the exact match and fall back to iexact only when it's unambiguous (or enforce case-insensitive uniqueness at registration with a data migration). The shared helper is a legitimate refactor.
